name: Production whole-system monitor
description: Thirteen-system operational monitoring: hourly snapshots, 90-day history, explicit evidence gaps and scheduler health.

cells.text:
# Production whole-system monitor

Compass, Sensing, community information, personalized media, Discovery, Input, Wall, Map, Trips, Events, Highlights, Moments and Stamps. Hourly snapshots cover the preceding 24 hours ending at the hour; history is retained for 90 days. Run this notebook to refresh the display.

**Observed** means telemetry exists, not that a system is accurate or A++. **No data**, **disabled**, **unreadable** and **stale** stay explicit. Latency percentiles need at least 60 valid samples. The monitor reads aggregate counters and stores no prompts, user identifiers, coordinates or media. No synthetic user activity is injected.

cells.title: Latest status — all thirteen systems
cells.sql: select systems.system, case when s.measured_at is null then 'not_collected' when s.measured_at < now()-interval '90 minutes' then 'stale' else s.state end as operational_status, s.sample_count, s.measured_at, s.window_start, s.window_end, coalesce(s.effectiveness,'unverified') as effectiveness, s.flags from (values ('compass'),('sensing'),('community'),('media'),('discovery'),('input'),('wall'),('map'),('trips'),('events'),('highlights'),('moments'),('stamps')) systems(system) left join lateral (select * from intelligence_monitor.snapshots s where s.system=systems.system order by measured_at desc limit 1) s on true order by systems.system;

cells.text:
## Quality target and evidence

A++ is the target for all thirteen systems. Code changes are evaluated by the repository’s cross-system regression suite and type checks. The dashboard records production activity and evidence gaps; it does not infer a grade from activity counts. Local fixes and production deployment remain separate states.

cells.title: Compass — latest measurements and limits
cells.sql: select metric.key as metric, metric.value from (select metrics from intelligence_monitor.snapshots where system='compass' order by measured_at desc limit 1) s cross join lateral jsonb_each(s.metrics) metric order by metric.key;

cells.title: Input latency trend — valid samples only
cells.sql: select measured_at, (metrics->>'server_p95_ms')::numeric as server_p95_ms, (metrics->>'client_p95_ms')::numeric as client_p95_ms, (metrics->>'server_timing_samples')::bigint as server_samples, (metrics->>'client_timing_samples')::bigint as client_samples from intelligence_monitor.snapshots where system='input' and measured_at >= now()-interval '30 days' order by measured_at;

cells.title: History — latest status changes and observation gaps
cells.sql: with history as (select system,measured_at,state,sample_count,lag(state) over(partition by system order by measured_at) as previous_state from intelligence_monitor.snapshots where measured_at >= now()-interval '30 days') select system,measured_at,previous_state,state,sample_count from history where state is distinct from previous_state order by measured_at desc,system limit 200;

cells.title: Collection job — schedule and last scheduled execution
cells.sql: select j.jobname,j.schedule,j.active,d.status as last_run_status,d.start_time,d.end_time,case when d.start_time is null then 'awaiting_first_scheduled_run' when d.start_time < now()-interval '90 minutes' then 'stale' when d.status='failed' then 'needs_attention' else d.status end as scheduler_health from cron.job j left join lateral (select status,start_time,end_time from cron.job_run_details d where d.jobid=j.jobid order by runid desc limit 1) d on true where j.jobname='intelligence-system-monitor-hourly';

cells.text:
## Interpretation

- Discovery impressions count item exposures, not unique people or requests. Taps and saves are counts, not causal conversion rates. Shadow timings are separate diagnostics.
- Input timing is client-reported; degraded responses are excluded from server timing. A blank percentile means insufficient valid samples.
- Compass covers persisted turns and recorded unavailability events; failures before persistence and answer quality require separate evaluation.
- Sensing's publication switch remains under its existing consent and rollout controls. A disabled capability is not a pass or a defect.
- Community volumes do not establish independence, accuracy or truth. Media processing status does not establish playback reliability or personalized relevance.
- No alerts are sent to others. Investigation flags and missing observations appear here. Scheduling failures are visible separately from system failures.

## A++ acceptance

A++ is a release target, not a label derived from activity counts. It requires passing correctness, privacy, authorization, recovery, accessibility and performance checks, plus representative live evaluations of usefulness. Local regression results are recorded in the repository; production effectiveness remains unverified until that evidence exists. Moments counts personal-memory creation; live Wall transitions are computed on read and are explicitly unmeasured here.
